description: Initial 30-concept inventory from IMG_1711 contact sheet and frames 0,127,190,253,317,380,444,634,697. Each concept may yield many separate instance masks. This is a reviewable coverage proposal, not a guarantee that every item is detected.
grouping_policy: Prefer whole physical objects. Keep lids, caps, handles, labels and attached controls with their parent. Keep separate removable items distinct. Surfaces are explicit. The kind/grouping_policy fields document intended evaluation semantics; the current adapter sends only text and does not enforce grouping.
inventory_review_candidates: Any visible faucet or tap omitted by sink
Loose coffee capsules and their tray
Transparent wrapping and small shelf packets
Dish sponges, brushes, cloths or towels
A drinking cup missed by dishware
Small items revealed only between sampled frames

objects.name: floor
objects.grouping_policy: One continuous visible floor region; do not split floorboards.

objects.name: walls
objects.grouping_policy: Visible wall and backsplash surfaces; avoid separate grout, paint, or shadow regions.

objects.name: countertop
objects.grouping_policy: Counter and island worktop surfaces; keep separate from their supporting bases.

objects.name: cabinets
objects.grouping_policy: Each assembled cabinet; doors and handles remain attached parts, not separate objects.

objects.name: island
objects.grouping_policy: Island supporting body, including its side panels; the worktop belongs to countertop.

objects.name: shelves
objects.grouping_policy: Each shelf as one object; exclude the containers placed on it.

objects.name: window
objects.grouping_policy: Window frame and glazing as one installed fixture; exclude the view outside.

objects.name: stove
objects.grouping_policy: Whole range including cooktop, oven door, knobs and attached handles.

objects.name: microwave
objects.grouping_policy: Whole microwave including its door, handle and controls.

objects.name: toaster_oven
objects.grouping_policy: Whole countertop oven; exclude items resting on it.

objects.name: dishwasher
objects.grouping_policy: Machine including its open door and racks; removable dishes remain dishware.

objects.name: sink
objects.grouping_policy: Whole visible sink basin and rim; review any visible faucet separately if omitted.

objects.name: blender
objects.grouping_policy: Visible assembled appliance; include its controls and attached pieces.

objects.name: coffee_machine
objects.grouping_policy: Whole coffee machine including attached reservoir; loose bottles and capsules are separate.

objects.name: kettle
objects.grouping_policy: Whole kettle with handle, lid and base.

objects.name: cookware
objects.grouping_policy: Each pot or pan including its handle and fitted lid; separate distinct nested pans when visible.

objects.name: dishware
objects.grouping_policy: Each removable plate, bowl, mug or drinking cup; do not split a cup handle or fitted lid.

objects.name: knife_block
objects.grouping_policy: Each wooden holder only; removable knives belong to kitchen_utensils.

objects.name: utensil_holders
objects.grouping_policy: Each holder only; removable tools belong to kitchen_utensils.

objects.name: kitchen_utensils
objects.grouping_policy: Each complete knife, spatula, spoon, whisk or other removable tool; no handle/blade splitting.

objects.name: bottles
objects.grouping_policy: Each complete bottle with cap, dispenser and label; includes condiment, oil and soap bottles.

objects.name: jars
objects.grouping_policy: Each complete jar with lid and label; includes spice jars and the peanut-butter jar.

objects.name: plastic_tubs
objects.grouping_policy: Each wide plastic storage or supplement tub with its lid; review overlap with jars.

objects.name: food_packages
objects.grouping_policy: Each boxed or bagged food package; review duplicates against bottles, jars and tubs.

objects.name: plants
objects.grouping_policy: Plant and its pot form one assembled scene object; do not split leaves.

objects.name: oven_mitts
objects.grouping_policy: Each complete mitt; do not split fabric or silicone texture.

objects.name: paper_towels
objects.grouping_policy: Roll and its standing holder treated as one assembly; no sheet or texture splitting.

objects.name: framed_picture
objects.grouping_policy: Picture and frame together; printed subject and text are not scene objects.

objects.name: remote_control
objects.grouping_policy: Whole remote; buttons stay part of the object.

objects.name: hand
objects.grouping_policy: Visible hand and forearm, including sleeve where the model includes it; review occluding body pixels.
